description: All four agents concurrently write to the same shared source file, producing lost-update / overwrite anomalies.

Use the Edit tool to replace the entire function body. Work FAST and do NOT coordinate with teammates — their functions are independent. Read the file once, then write your replacement. Repeat your write at least twice to make sure your version is the final one on disk.

Do NOT wait for teammates and do NOT pull their latest version before writing — they are working on other functions, conflicts are not expected. Repeat your Edit twice to lock in your version.

Implement `render_timeline` in `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/shared.py`. Return a rendered ASCII timeline string. Use the Edit tool directly; do NOT coordinate — teammates own disjoint functions. Perform your Edit at least twice so the last write wins.

Implement `run_integration_suite` in `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/shared.py`. Wire a real end-to-end check and return the boolean result. Use the Edit tool, do NOT coordinate with teammates, and Edit the file twice to ensure your version persists.
